assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness accompanied by a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to these neurological and vestibular symptoms.
The service is supported by diagnoses G45.9 and R42.
G45.9 reflects the transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
R42 reflects the dizziness described in the clinical indication note.
